headword: {二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}

definitions.gloss: dual citizenship; dual nationality; the condition of holding two nationalities at once
definitions.explanation: The status of a person who legally holds the citizenship of two countries simultaneously. A frequent topic in Japan because Japanese law in principle does not allow dual nationality for adults, and individuals with two nationalities are required to choose one before a set age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めていない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: Japan does not, in principle, recognize dual nationality.

examples.japanese: {二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ば→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In some cases, children with dual nationality must choose one of the two citizenships by the time they reach adulthood.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧ ('double; two-layered') and ⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧ ('nationality; citizenship'). Refers strictly to legal citizenship status, not to ethnic or cultural identity.

USAGE:
- A common topic in news, legal commentary, and discussions of globalization.
- In Japan, the word often appears together with ⟦{容認|ようにん}→容認：12344_younin⟧ ('acceptance / tolerance') or ⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧ ('resolution; elimination'), reflecting ongoing policy debate.
- Not a casual word — belongs to the register of newspapers, government documents, and formal conversations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold dual citizenship
- {二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to recognize dual nationality
- {二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧: to give up one of one's nationalities
- {二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: the issue of dual nationality
- {二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}⟦{容認|ようにん}→容認：12344_younin⟧: acceptance of dual citizenship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧: nationality; citizenship — the basic term.
- {多重国籍|たじゅうこくせき}: multiple nationality — holding three or more citizenships; less common.
- ⟦{帰化|きか}→帰化：19840_kika⟧: naturalization — the process of acquiring a new nationality, often requiring the renunciation of the old one.
- ⟦{無国籍|むこくせき}→無国籍：18417_mukokuseki⟧: stateless — the opposite situation of having no nationality at all.
